The '''ivory box''' is a ''[[ter'angreal]]'' that was found in the [[Kin's Storeroom]] in [[Ebou Dar]].{{ref/book|8|2}}

==Appearance==
The box appears to be made of ivory and is decorated with rippling red and green stripes, with a hinged lid.

==Use==
The box contains music, possibly thousands of songs, much like a music box. The method of playing the songs is still unknown.{{ref/book|11|15}}
